parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with preserved R-wave progression and no pathological Q waves in V1–V4; the mild concave ST/J-point elevation with tall T waves in V2–V4 looks like a benign early-repolarization pattern, not the convex ST elevation of an anterior MI, so I can't support anterior MI and it doesn't meet STEMI criteria.
